amendments.rule: Use in-memory service HOLD with zero new DB worker/mutation until actual prior writer cleanup is established. Do not persist InboxHold as the first response to unknown writer state. After proven whole-unit cleanup recover verified current ledger state; exact old-operation reconciliation still requires original canonical context.

Opaque receipt minted by actual lifecycle observation; bind unit, InvocationID, store incarnation/database and pinned worker/guardian association. Registration must precede worker launch and survive VM death. Never accept a caller-constructed record or Boolean. Stop completion plus recursive cgroup emptiness is required; parent cgroup.procs empty, unit inactive or missing directory alone are insufficient.

Create only fresh uniquely named private test units. Validate exact non-glob unit identity and ownership, not prefix alone. No Herdr/current UOS/production unit mutation. Systemctl stop implementation details cannot be asserted as cgroup.kill without observation.

rest_for_one child3 failure restarts child4. Specify bounded queues, cancel/monitor behavior, stop new admissions on observed authority loss and preserve uncertain in-flight external outcomes. Do not claim distributed checks occur atomically at one instant.

Runtime worker identity comes from trusted service config/current canonical claim, never hardcoded development AGY worker. Current per-request Sa-plan owner/attempt/lease and resource epoch checks occur at effect boundary. Logical remote effect IDs survive authority epochs; new storage transitions must not replay an uncertain remote effect.

Reuse evaluate_update(raw,Allowlist), read_inbox_records and codec key functions. Source has a bounded inbox index; root's earlier absence claim is retracted. Callback decoding, guarded acknowledgment and task authority are new implementation obligations.

Separate opaque/private HTTP config from storage config. Bound body and time. Delivered requires positive valid message_id, ok=true and intended chat. Only proven rejection becomes Failed; sanitize error categories and never reflect raw private errors. Uncertain outcomes are not blindly retried.

Real HTTP fixture is planned until actually built/run. Use canonical18 core obligations plus provenance extension without unsupported pass/consensus claims. Align ASCII/Mermaid or omit diagrams. Correct v2 wording as implementation proceeds; preserve original records.

Independent root candidate review while AGY task remains executing; no production deployment during development
